briefing:
أهلاً بك يا قائد. بصفتي المدير الفني الأعلى كفاءة لفريقك، إليك التقرير التكتيكي الشامل للجولة رقم 5. مبدؤنا ثابت: **"النقاط هي النقاط"**، ولا مكان للجمود أو العاطفة في قراراتنا.

---

### 1. التكتيك المعتمد وموقف الترتيب (Strategy & Rank Status)

* **الوضع الحالي:** الترتيب العام (10,622,169) يتطلب منا تفعيل **النمط الهجومي التعويضي (AGGRESSIVE)**. الهدف ليس مجرد مجارات المنافسين، بل اختراق صفوفهم وقفز مراتب واسعة.
* **الرسم التكتيكي (3-5-2):** اعتمدنا هيكلية تُعظّم النقاط المتوقعة (xP) من خط الوسط المكون من 5 لاعبين يمتلكون جميعاً نزعة هجومية حادة، مدعومين بخط هجوم قوي وثلاثي دفاعي ذي عائد مزدوج (Clean Sheet + أهداف رأسية).

---

### 2. التحليل الرياضي والتكتيكي للتبديلات (Transfer Breakdown)

* **القرار:** 🔴 بيع: **Stach** (MID - LEE) ──► 🟢 شراء: **Tavernier** (MID - BOU)
* **التكلفة:** **0 نقطة** (تبديل مجاني).
* **العائد الرياضي المباشر:** صافي زيادة متوقعة **+1.57 نقطة** لهذه الجولة فقط.

#### **تأسيس القرار والتبرير الفني:**
1. **التخلص من Stach (xP: 5.8):** التراجع الإحصائي وسقف النقاط المحدود يفرضان بيعه فوراً بدون عواطف.
2. **استقدام Tavernier (xP: 7.4 | السعر: £6.1m):**
   * **القيمة التكتيكية:** لاعب يُعتبر "FPL Differential" ممتاز في هذه المرحلة. يتكفل بالكرات الثابتة ويمتلك جودة التسديد من الخارج.
   * **نظرة على جدول الجولات الـ 3 القادمة:**
     * **الجولة 5 - LIV (H) [FDR: 4]:** على الرغم من صعوبة المواجهة شكلياً، إلا أن ليفربول يترك مساحات للتحولات السريعة، وتفرّد Tavernier بالكرات الثابتة يرفع من فرص مساهماته.

Ipswich (A) tickets
press_wire.summary: Tickets for Fulham's away trip to Portman Road will begin to go on sale from tomorrow! Join us on the road as we face Ipswich Town in Premier League action on Saturday 10th October, kick-off 3pm! Tickets for this fixture will go on sale to 2026/27 Season Ticket Holders at 2pm on Wednesday 16th September. 2026/27 Members will be able to purchase tickets from 9:30am on Friday 18th September. Any remaining tickets will then go on sale to Supporters with Previous Booking History from 9:30am on Monday 21st September. Further matchday information, including a full list of on sale dates and ticket prices, can be found here. Supporters can purchase up to two tickets per person online at fulhamfc.com/tickets, by calling the Ticket Office on 0203 871 0810 (Mon-Fri, 9:30am-5pm) or in person from the Ticket Office (Mon-Fri, 9:30am-4:30pm). BUY TICKETS FROM WEDNESDAY Important Information The 2026/27 season will see new Premier League requirements implemented for assigning tickets to supporters, with every seat sold being assigned to the individual who intends on attending the related match. Each attendee's name and contact details must be registered with the club. This means if a supporter purchases two tickets for a fixture, each ticket will need to be assigned to a unique client reference number. In the instance of a Season Ticket Holder purchasing additional tickets during their priority window, each ticket that they are purchasing will need to be assigned to each individual who intends on attending the related match. We therefore encourage all supporters planning on attending Premier League fixtures, home or away, to update their friends and family network ahead of the start of the season to ensure they can easily assign tickets at the point of purchase. Supporters can follow our step-by-step guide on how to do this here.

press_wire.title: Fan Engagement Plan 2026/27
press_wire.summary: Aston Villa is pleased to release the club’s Fan Engagement Plan for the 2026/27 season. Our supporters are central to the identity, heritage and future of the Club. This plan sets out how we will engage with fans throughout the season and work towards our ambition of delivering best-in-class fan engagement. Our Fan Advisory Board will remain the principal forum for structured dialogue, supported by working groups, supporter organisations, surveys, fan forums and direct consultation. These channels will help supporters contribute to discussions on subjects including heritage assets, ticketing, matchday experience, accessibility, equality, diversity and inclusion. We will communicate openly, listen carefully and report on our progress. By involving supporters from across our local, national and international fanbase, we aim to make better-informed decisions and strengthen the connection between Aston Villa and the people who represent it. In our Fan Engagement Plan, supporters can read a message from President of Business Operations Francesco Calvo, discover the club’s aims and objectives, key personnel, heritage assets, structure of the Fan Advisory Board, additional working groups, wider consultation and more. For further information on our Fan Engagement Plans and Reports, including our 2026/27 edition, click here. Aston Villa Fan Engagement Plan 2026/27

press_wire.title: Goal-Hungry Barry Explains Importance Of Shifting Focus
press_wire.summary: Thierno Barry admits he was left "sad" at being denied adding to his early-season goal tally during Everton's goalless draw at Tottenham Hotspur – and says he is hungry to get back on the scoresheet ahead of an important double-header at Hill Dickinson Stadium. The Blues host Wolves in the Carabao Cup third round on Wednesday, with Barry looking to keep up momentum after being named Player of the Round for a superb hat-trick in the 4-0 away victory over Preston North End in the previous stage of the competition. Then the Toffees switch their focus back to Premier League matters this weekend with the visit of Ipswich Town, before an extended international break. press_wire.title: Three points in Europe and Alysson off the mark
press_wire.summary: We are two more games down in the world of Aston Villa, who are now on the board in this season’s UEFA Champions League. The Villans secured a 3-2 triumph over Club Brugge in an entertaining clash in Belgium last week, before netting their opening goal of the Premier League season against Nottingham Forest at Villa Park on Saturday. The weekend delivered Alysson’s first strike in claret and blue, after Nicolas Jackson had done similar at Jan Breydelstadion in European action. And Villa’s first team stars have been as active as ever across social media over the past seven days. Here are some posts you may have missed… UCL action begins Three first-half goals in Bruges saw the Villans emerge victorious in their first Champions League game of the season, making a winning start to the league phase. Captain John McGinn joined Jackson in toasting three points, after Leon Goretzka had delivered a heartfelt message on Instagram the day before… Narrowly defeated in B6 Alysson’s maiden Villa goal could not help Emery’s men from falling to defeat on home soil over the weekend. The Brazilian celebrated a proud personal achievement, while injured Ian Maatsen began the road to recovery…
